display_name: PAMF-Sup 五分支真标签物理方向保护三种子
scope: Phase1 ManySig F0, seeds 2026092701/02/03, old complete PAMF, 3 SIG-TIME views, natural order, original complete PAMF-Sup L objective (not CE-only).
initialization: Exact same-seed historical F20 scratch E20 from the matched PAMF-Sup control; check actual zero U exposure and checkpoint provenance. Own E10+E20 to fixed E50.
method: Original L-only supervised objective plus weight .05 five-branch physical relations, beta .5, 64 same-batch L draws. Remove the detached true-label centroid contrast projection from each bounded echo direction. No U loader, pseudo labels, teacher or target training inputs.
controls: same-seed original PAMF-Sup with the same F20 E20 prefix and DURA
same-seed ordinary PL and complete Tri-SIG-TIME SSL as additional references
evaluation: Clean and six practical scenes, DURA-LU as the requested overall readout and DURA-L for a system with L-only F and G. Raw also reported. All three prediction matrices frozen before independent truth-last scoring. No leo_weak. No target feedback into checkpoints or recipe.
execution: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_sup.publish --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 existing project Python, FP32/TF32 off, immutable Git release commit, PROJECT/releases/RUN-release CWD, PROJECT/runs/RUN output root.
resources: Ordinary account, user-authorized GPU 2/3/4. At most two observed or pending experiments per GPU; preserve healthy owners. One source-only smoke spanning the three real E20 checkpoints.
stop_rule: Systemic training, prediction or scoring failure stops new dispatch and preserves healthy workers and outputs. No optional source diagnostic dispatch.
expected_artifacts: own E30/E50, L physical update counts and zero U exposure
independent scores and same-packet three-seed comparisons
limitations: A true-label intervention test on the complete original PAMF-Sup recipe. A positive result would not establish effects for pure CE, other splits or fewer labels. Benchmark was previously exposed.
